description: Task -> base template -> applicable modifiers routing table for input_build. Machine-readable routing index enforced by tests/test_template_index.py and summarized by SKILL.md 'Template & Modifier Routing'. NOT a single source of truth: parameter rules also live in SKILL.md, base templates, modifiers, references/ and scripts/validate_input.py; where sources disagree, the stricter rule wins and the disagreement is a bug.

semantics.application: Start from the base template, then overlay modifiers in listed order. On keyword collision, the LATER modifier wins. Modifiers are INCAR snippets for AI-guided overlay (v1); they are not applied by a script.
semantics.post_condition: After overlaying modifiers, the result MUST pass scripts/validate_input.py with zero ERROR findings.

relax.notes: Never overlay the semiconductor modifier here: ISMEAR=-5 (tetrahedron) is for static SCF/DOS with a dense automatic k-mesh, not for relax/MD

slowgrowth.notes: SG-AIMD two-stage protocol: equilibration (INCREM=0, LBLUEOUT=.FALSE.) then growth (INCREM!=0, LBLUEOUT=.TRUE.), sharing one ICONST. MDALGO must be 1 or 2 (Langevin MDALGO=3 unsupported). Generate ICONST and both stage INCARs with scripts/iconst_helper.py render --emit-incar; see references/vasp.md 'Slow-growth AIMD'

phonon.notes: Single-point forces for phonopy finite displacements; distinct from the freq task (IBRION=5 molecular vibrations)

md.notes: multi-stage: minimize -> slow heating -> NVT -> NPT(optional) -> production; consult references/lammps_best_practices.md

npt.notes: uses lammps_md.in with NPT stage uncommented

mlff.notes: MLFF-specific MD; model path and element order MUST come from the user

conp.notes: constant-potential electrode; requires LAMMPS built with the ELECTRODE package and an /electrode kspace style

plumed.notes: requires the PLUMED package; only one fix plumed; its group-ID is ignored (always all)

neb.notes: replica run via -partition NxM; min_style quickmin/fire only; atom_modify map required

ivdw.apply_when: Weak interactions: physisorption, layered materials, organic adsorbates on surfaces
ivdw.notes: IVDW=12 is DFT-D3(BJ). IVDW=11 is D3 zero-damping — do not mix up.

dipole.apply_when: Asymmetric slab or single-sided adsorbate with vacuum > 5 A
dipole.notes: IDIPOL selects the lattice-vector axis (1/2/3 = a/b/c). Requires LDIPOL=.TRUE. or the correction is inactive.

magnetic.apply_when: Fe/Co/Ni/Mn/Cr, rare earths (Ce/U/La), or radical adsorbates
magnetic.notes: Auto-enables ISPIN=2 only; magnetic ordering and MAGMOM must be confirmed with the user.

semiconductor.apply_when: Semiconductor/insulator static SCF or DOS with a dense automatic k-mesh
semiconductor.notes: ISMEAR=-5 tetrahedron. Never for relax/MD, molecules/Gamma-only, or line-mode band paths.

dftu.apply_when: Strongly correlated d/f elements; the vasp_dftu task template already embeds this
dftu.notes: LMAXMIX is mandatory: 4 for d-electrons, 6 for f-electrons. LDAUL/U/J must be per-element in POSCAR order.

optics.apply_when: Frequency-dependent dielectric function via LOPTICS (NSCF run)
optics.notes: Never combine LOPTICS with LEPSILON (dielectric task) in one INCAR.

solvation.apply_when: Aqueous electrochemistry / interface energetics with implicit water (VASPsol)
solvation.notes: Requires a VASPsol-patched VASP binary; PREC=Accurate and ENCUT >= 1.3x vacuum. Workflow: vacuum run with LWAVE=.TRUE., restart with ISTART=1.

efield.apply_when: Slab under an applied sawtooth field (electrode polarization / potential ramp)
efield.notes: REQUIRES the dipole modifier (IDIPOL+LDIPOL) or the field is not applied. Ramp in ~0.1-0.2 eV/A steps across restarts.

efield_lammps.apply_when: LAMMPS electrolyte / slab MD under a uniform applied electric field
efield_lammps.notes: Snippet block (fix efield); acts on charged atoms. Not for constant-potential electrodes — use the conp task.

shake_lammps.apply_when: Water/aqueous MD with rigid water constraints (O-H bonds + H-O-H angle); enables a 2 fs timestep
shake_lammps.notes: Requires the RIGID package; small-molecule clusters only. MUST be defined after all force-adding fixes (fix efield, fix wall/...) or constraints are not satisfied.

analysis_rdf_msd.apply_when: Production MD needing liquid structure (RDF) or transport (MSD/diffusion) analysis
analysis_rdf_msd.notes: compute rdf/msd + fix ave/time (mode vector); compute coord/atom and orientorder/atom (Q6) also available.

analysis_hbond.notes: LAMMPS has NO native hbond compute; RDF + post-processing (MDAnalysis/OVITO, O...O < 3.5 A, angle OOH < 30 deg).

ensemble_langevin.apply_when: NVT via fix nve + fix langevin instead of fix nvt (choose one)
ensemble_langevin.notes: damp ~ 100 fs (0.1 ps in units metal); seed is required.

temp_ramp.apply_when: Linear heating/cooling across a run (annealing, melting)
temp_ramp.notes: fix nvt temp Tstart Tstop Tdamp; ramp rate = (Tstop-Tstart)/(run x timestep); typical 0.1-1 K/ps.

dump_full.apply_when: Trajectory with velocities + forces (MLFF active learning, error estimation)
dump_full.notes: dump custom id type x y z vx vy vz fx fy fz + dump_modify sort id.

wall_slab.apply_when: Liquid/solid interface: confine liquid with soft walls instead of opening a vacuum gap
wall_slab.notes: fix wall/lj93 zlo/zhi EDGE epsilon sigma cutoff; keeps p p p + kspace unlike a vacuum gap. Define before fix shake.

soc.apply_when: Spin-orbit coupling: heavy elements, SOC band splitting, magnetic anisotropy
soc.notes: Non-collinear: NBANDS ~2x the scalar value (set explicitly); LMAXMIX 4 (d) / 6 (f); ENCUT 1.3-1.5x; moments are projections along SAXIS.

metagga.apply_when: meta-GGA accuracy upgrade over PBE (r2SCAN recommended; SCAN alternative)
metagga.notes: VASP >= 6.2.0 native (5.4.4 needs patch 4); LASPH=.TRUE. mandatory; ADDGRID=.TRUE. recommended.

empty.apply_when: Format reference only — do NOT apply
empty.notes: Documents the required patch file format for new modifiers.
